convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicator (ColorLaguerre) requiring custom indicator file, and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution logic (open/close positions, margin management). The custom indicator and trade library must be manually reimplemented.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of indicator timeframe
min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator calculation

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position (buy signal closes sell, sell signal closes buy) when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose enabled
Additional reversal close: if SellPosOpen&&SellPosClose and indicator buffer[1]==1, close sell; if BuyPosOpen&&BuyPosClose and buffer[1]==2, close buy

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum (LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss). Default LOT mode means MM=0.1 is fixed lot size. Other modes interpret MM as a percentage fraction.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal logic: ColorLaguerre buffer 1 values are integer-coded (1=downtrend, 2=uptrend). Long entry: TrendValue[0]==2 && TrendValue[1]==1 (trend shifted from 1 to 2 on SignalBar). Short entry: TrendValue[0]==1 && TrendValue[1]==2 (trend shifted from 2 to 1 on SignalBar). Signal bar defaults to bar[1] (previous completed bar). When SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated on every tick instead of only on new bars. Additional close logic: if both open and close flags are enabled for same side, the EA also closes positions when the indicator remains at the opposite trend level (buffer[1]==1 for sell close, buffer[1]==2 for buy close) without requiring a crossover. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to trade functions and may be used for order expiration or slippage timing.
python_conversion_notes: The Laguerre indicator must be reimplemented in Python - it is a custom indicator based on the Laguerre filter (gamma-weighted 4-element FIR filter). The TrendValue buffer is discrete (1=bearish, 2=bullish), making signal detection straightforward once the indicator is ported. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose and GlobalVariableDel_ - these must be reimplemented with the 5 MarginMode variants. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) which likely need digit-adjustment for 5-digit brokers. The conditional position sizing with 5 modes adds complexity. New bar detection via CIsNewBar class needs a simple Python equivalent.
